edit.statement: A subsidiary of a subsidiary is not automatically a subsidiary of the top company.
edit.subject: subsidiaryOf
edit.original: If one company is a subsidiary of a second, which is itself a subsidiary of a third, the first is also a subsidiary of the third.
edit.scope: Direct or indirect subsidiaries in an ownership hierarchy without cycles.
